notes: SMS parser rebuilt to be bank-agnostic instead of one regex guess per bank: recognizes the full debit/credit keyword vocabulary (withdrawn, spent, paid, deducted, purchase, sent, transferred, deposited, received, refund, reversed, added - not just "debited"/"credited"), in either word order and with or without a currency symbol, plus dedicated UPI/DR//UPI/CR reference-line parsing. This targets the confirmed under-10%-capture bug on phones using banks other than ICICI/SBI. Also: reference-ID-based duplicate detection (catches the same transaction described by two different SMS), a new SMS Scan Diagnostics tool in Profile > Diagnostics (see exactly how many SMS were found/parsed/skipped/duplicated on your phone), "Delete All My Data" renamed to "Clear All My Data and Log Out" and fixed so SMS history actually re-scans fresh afterward, and an AI chat guardrail against confidently forecasting from too little history.
